letterhead: Office: DEMO telephone line held by the school

paragraphs.text: At the start of the extra support the DEMO Letter Sounds score was 8. The latest score is 10 (2027-04-19). The aim is 20.

paragraphs.heading: What your child can do now:
paragraphs.text: Says several letter sounds and loves telling stories aloud.

paragraphs.heading: The next step:
paragraphs.text: We will keep practising letter sounds in short sessions at school.

paragraphs.heading: How you can help at home:
paragraphs.text: Please listen to your child say the letter sounds for five minutes a day.
Aan die begin van die ekstra ondersteuning was die DEMO Number Sense-telling 9. Die jongste telling is 12 (2027-04-19). Die doel is 12.

paragraphs.heading: Wat u kind nou kan doen:
paragraphs.text: Tel goed met voorwerpe en werk graag in 'n klein groep.

paragraphs.heading: Die volgende stap:
paragraphs.text: Ons gaan voort met klein groep oefening om getalwoorde te leer.

paragraphs.heading: Hoe u by die huis kan help:
paragraphs.text: Oefen asseblief saam met u kind tot 20 by die huis.

payload.rules: No diagnostic term appears. The letter says what the learner can do and the next step, and states the measured scores plainly. It does not announce any proposal: only what the School-Based Support Team ratifies is acted on. A language other than English is used only with a named human reader. Only guardians with a recorded lawful basis receive a letter. Support letters are seen by the Teacher and then the School-Based Support Team.
